id: title:Gilbert09:treat generic linkedin 404 as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds LinkedIn Ads warehouse ingestion error handling and regression tests.
review.reason: Adds LinkedIn Ads warehouse ingestion error handling and regression tests.
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned based on the observed addition of a specific error mapping and a corresponding test. While this improves the reliability and diagnostics of the LinkedIn Ads warehouse ingestion, the score is not elevated to Tier 3 because the implementation does not demonstrate a broader systemic capability or a reduction of systemic risk across multiple components or the end

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error mapping for LinkedIn API 404 responses with code "NOT_FOUND" alongside existing "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND".
observations.code_quote: '"code":"NOT_FOUND"': "LinkedIn could not find the requested ad account. It may have been deleted, the configured Account ID may be wrong, or PostHog may have lost access. Check the Account ID and re-authorize the LinkedIn Ads integration.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change expands LinkedIn Ads warehouse ingestion error handling, allowing PostHog to recognize and stop retrying on a specific LinkedIn 404 variant that previously might have been misclassified or retried. This could prevent unnecessary retry loops and provide clearer failure diagnostics for warehouse ingestion failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a corresponding test case for the new LinkedIn 404 error variant.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression test coverage for the newly supported LinkedIn error variant, helping PostHog maintain reliability of warehouse ingestion error classification.
